title: Workspace Permission Horizon Panel with Rollback Scenarios
creator: Ava Chen
description: Design and prototype a compact "horizon panel" for workspace-level permissions that surfaces role composition, recent permission changes, cost attribution links, and one-click rollback scenarios. The panel will live in the workspace settings header and in audit-log detail flyouts. It should make it easy for admins to understand who has critical privileges, how those privileges changed over time, and to preview and execute safe rollbacks via guided canary steps. We aim for a tight, scannable UI for on-call and compliance reviewers that reduces time-to-triage for permission incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Horizon panel mockups (desktop and tablet) exist in Figma with annotated states: default, expanded, role-diff hover, and rollback-confirm
Panel shows aggregated badge counts (admins, editors, billing, deploy) and top 5 principals with role chips and last-change timestamp
Audit-log detail view links to the same panel contextualized to a single permission change event
Rollback flow shows 3-step guided preview: impact simulation, canary cohort selection, and confirmation with automatic change notes
Accessibility: color contrast and keyboard focus states validated; role chips readable by screen readers
Design handoff includes tokens, spacing, and micro-interaction specs for engineering (Figma + note page)
comments: 2026-03-10 Ava Chen: Initial framing and problem statement added. Key goals: reduce mean time to remediate permission incidents, make rollbacks auditable and reversible.

2026-03-11 Liam Ortega: Drafted three layout variants: compact badge row, split timeline+summary, and modal-first approach. Leaning toward compact badge row for workspace header and split timeline for audit flyout.
2026-03-11 Priya Rao (PM): Good alignment with compliance goals. Please add a clear copy path for 'why this change happened' linked to the originating PR or SSO action.
2026-03-11 Marcus Feld (Engineering): Need clarity on rollback constraints — server must surface candidate snapshots and a dry-run API. Marked ENG-8123 as dependency.

2026-03-12 Design review: cross-functional feedback captured. Action: update hover state to show 'affected resources' preview and include cost-attribution link to Route cost breakdowns. Assign to Liam for updated mocks.
2026-03-12 Compliance review (Elena Park): Suggested adding an approval gate for rollbacks when customer_impact is high; flagged security_review_required=true.
decisions: Use a compact horizontal 'badge row' in the workspace header to surface counts and primary admins; clicking expands into a contextual panel with timeline and rollback actions.
Rollback flow will be gated by an approval step for changes that affect billing or dedicated capacity; UX will include clear audit entries and automated change notes.
Integrate cost-linking to existing console cost views rather than reimplementing attribution; link opens per-route cost modal scoped to affected resources.
next_steps: Iterate Figma mocks to include affected-resources hover card and canary cohort picker (owner: Liam)
Work with Engineering to define dry-run API contract and required fields (owner: Marcus, dependency ENG-8123)
Schedule usability session with two on-call operators and one compliance reviewer (owner: Ava)
Produce final handoff package: annotated Figma, interaction spec, copy guidelines, and PR checklist for feature flag rollout
